changes: Long test names now fit on the answer sheet. Before, a name of about 45 letters or more ran into the black corner squares and QuickCheck could not read the papers. Now a long name gets a little smaller, then goes onto two lines. Print your sheets again if a long name stopped them from being read.

Activate with a license code: paste the code you received, like QC-7KMP-2XRT-9HWA-4NBE, on the Activate screen and press Activate. Dashes and spaces don't matter. It works on the laptop and the phone, and the same code covers your one laptop and one phone.
Key files (.qckey) still work, under "I have a key file" on the same screen.
A Bible verse to encourage you, morning and afternoon, on Home and along the bottom of every page (Settings → A verse for you: twice a day, once a day or off).
Go Pro: a new Choose your plan page with the same plans as the website.
A new look, the same on the laptop and the phone: Home, Tests, Check, Results and Settings in the same places, in new emerald colours on a white background, with larger words and numbers.
On the laptop: a slim bar of icons on the left. Click it and it opens with every name. Each page sits in the middle of the screen with room on both sides, and keys 1 to 5 still open the five places.
The bottom of the laptop window shows your phone: linked and when it last synced, syncing, or why it is not, plus how many papers wait to be checked. Ctrl K opens Search from any page.
A test, a result or a class now has the list of the others beside it, so you can open the next one without going back.
Checking papers shows three steps across the top: Get papers, Fix names and answers, Save to the class record.
Results are grouped by class, with a box to find a test, a class picker, and a sort that can put the lowest class average first.
The class record works like a spreadsheet on the laptop: Enter and the arrow keys move between boxes, Ctrl S saves.
